title: Director, Customer Support Network Strategy, Service Design & Workforce Management
description:
Wolt and Roo operate under the DoorDash umbrella, and Customer Support sits at the intersection of brand experience, unit economics and long-term growth. This role owns the strategy on:

  1. Where should we operate support, at what scale, and at what cost, across a rolling multi-year horizon?
  2. How do we architect frontline service design to be AI-ready as frontline tooling evolves, deliver best-in-class customer experience, and remain cost-efficient?
  3. How do we manage our workforce with precision, eliminating waste, consolidating overlapping structures, and continuously improving headcount efficiency through automation and org redesign?

This is a permanent leadership role. The person in this seat will own network strategy, service design and workforce management as a continuous discipline, embedding deeply into Wolt, Roo and DoorDash technology stacks, building and refreshing the financial and operational case for change, and evolving the execution roadmap as the business, technology and market shift.

Scope of Responsibility

A. Support Service Design

  • Own the demand and supply planning, and scheduling for the network, partnering deeply with upstream business owners and defect elimination to enable forecasting accuracy. 
  • Own ongoing assessment of how service is structured and delivered at the frontline across both brands.
  • Maintain the role architecture map: what roles exist, what they do, where they overlap.
  • Evaluate how tools (CRM, WFM, knowledge base, AI tools, ticketing) enable or constrain frontline roles, and keep this view current as tooling changes.
  • Own and evolve the target-state frontline model aligned to AI-augmented ways of working.
  • Continuously run gap analysis: current state vs. target state, with prioritised interventions.

B. Support Site Strategy

  • Own the support site footprint across both brands as an ongoing portfolio.
  • Maintain and refresh strategic site scenarios across cost, quality, risk and scalability as conditions change.
  • Own the financial model underpinning site strategy: OpEx, CapEx, transition cost, and planning cycles.
  • Continuously assess BPO vs. in-house mix, nearshore vs. offshore trade-offs, and consolidation opportunities.
  • Bring forward exec-ready recommendations as circumstances warrant, with clear pros, cons and decision criteria.
  • Keep the site strategy framed against contact volume reduction through automation.

C. Workforce Management Transformation

  • Own WFM maturity across both brands on an ongoing basis: demand forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, real-time management.
  • Identify and close tooling gaps and duplication across Wolt and Roo WFM stacks.
  • Own and evolve the consolidated WFM target operating model.
  • Own the continuous efficiency case, driven through:
    • Org consolidation:  merging duplicated WFM roles across the two brands.
    • Contact automation: defect elimination and end-to-end customer-facing automation.
    • AI-assisted agent workflows: human-in-the-loop bot interfaces, AI-guided resolution, next-best-action tools.
    • Scheduling and real-time optimisation via AI/ML tooling.
  • Own tooling requirements and vendor strategy (shortlists, entries, exits) as an ongoing responsibility.

D. DoorDash Technology Integration

  • Maintain deep, current working knowledge of DoorDash's support technology stack.
  • Continuously translate technology capabilities into concrete business levers for the Wolt and Roo context.
  • Own the dependency map between integration milestones and the Support transformation roadmap.
  • Flag risks early where integration timelines could affect strategy execution.

E. Execution Planning

  • Own the rolling execution plan: prioritised initiatives, owners, investment, expected outcomes, refreshed as priorities shift.
  • Own the forward-looking roadmap: strategic bets, sequencing logic, capability-build requirements.
  • Own stakeholder alignment across Support Operations, Product, Finance and People functions on an ongoing basis.

Core Ongoing Responsibilities & Outcomes

  • Current state visibility: Maintain a living view of service design, site footprint, financial planning cycles and WFM maturity across Wolt & Roo, with an opinionated, forward-looking perspective on where the network needs to go.
  • DoorDash technology translation: Continuously map DoorDash technology capabilities to Wolt/Roo business levers, tracking upstream product, tooling and integration roadmaps and their implications for network design.
  • Support site strategy: Maintain a multi-year scenario model with full financial analysis, pros & cons, and a standing recommended path, developed in partnership with the wider Strategy and Operations organisation.
  • Planning mechanisms: Own and run weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual mechanisms for demand and supply planning (long and short term) and scheduling/real-time management, optimising for customer experience and efficiency, with clear visibility for executive leadership.
  • WFM transformation: Own the consolidated operating model, tooling spec, and the efficiency case for the organisation, with signed-off financial projections refreshed as the business evolves.
  • Roadmap ownership: Maintain a rolling forward roadmap covering strategic sequencing, capability investments, and automation maturity milestones, ratified through regular leadership review.
  • Stakeholder alignment: Keep all key workstream owners briefed, committed and clear on accountabilities on an ongoing basis.

All recommendations must be underpinned by a financial model, and must be decision-ready on first presentation.

Operating Rhythm

  • Embed & Orient (ongoing as scope evolves): Maintain stakeholder maps; stay immersed in Wolt, Roo & DoorDash systems; keep baseline data current; revisit scope and success criteria as the business changes.
  • Diagnose: Continuously reassess current state across all workstreams; keep DoorDash tech translation current; surface risks and quick wins as they emerge.
  • Design & Model: Maintain and evolve site strategy scenarios, the frontline service design blueprint, the WFM target model, and supporting financial models.
  • Synthesise & Align: Run regular executive forums and stakeholder sign-off cycles.
  • Roadmap & Continuity: Maintain the forward roadmap; ensure knowledge is embedded across the team rather than concentrated in one person.

Required Competencies

Competency

What Good Looks Like

Strategic clarity

Translates complexity into a small number of decisive choices. Never produces a report that fails to recommend.

Financial rigour

Builds robust P&L and scenario models independently. Understands how operational levers flow to unit economics.

CX & support operations depth

Credible across service design, contact centre strategy, WFM and automation.

AI & tooling fluency

Understands AI automation in a CX context: IVR/chatbot design, agent assist tools, LLM-powered workflows.

Speed to competence

Gets up to speed fast on unfamiliar technology stacks. Can read a product and understand business implications without hand-holding.

Stakeholder influence

Earns trust quickly at VP level and above. Drives alignment without authority. Comfortable challenging conventional thinking.

Structured communication

Writes concisely and presents with clarity.

Operator's mindset

Thinks in outcomes and owns them over time.

Experience Profile

Essential

  • 10+ years in customer support strategy, CX operations or contact centre consulting/leadership.
  • Demonstrable experience designing and executing site strategy at scale (multi-site, multi-brand, international).
  • Deep workforce management expertise: forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, real-time management.
  • Experience leading or sponsoring automation programmes, contact reduction, chatbot, AI agent-assist.
  • Track record of delivering headcount efficiencies without degrading quality.
  • Strong financial modelling capability, built business cases independently.
  • Experience working inside or alongside a fast-growth tech company or marketplace.

Highly Desirable

  • Direct experience in food delivery, logistics or three-sided marketplace support.
  • Prior exposure to DoorDash, Wolt or comparable platforms.
  • Background delivering inside complex integrations or M&A contexts.
  • Familiarity with WFM platforms (e.g. Verint, AWS Connect, Assembled, Calibrio) and CX tooling (e.g. Zendesk, Intercom).

Ways of Working

  • This is a hands-on leadership role. 
  • The role requires deep, ongoing immersion in internal data, systems and teams.
  • All recommendations must arrive decision-ready.
  • The role operates with a high degree of autonomy, with regular visibility to leadership through written updates and reviews.
  • Escalation discipline: flag blockers fast. Never sit on a problem for more than 48 hours.
  • Intellectual honesty is non-negotiable.

We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. Data is central to how we understand our customers, shape our products, manage risk and grow Monzo sustainably. We believe in empowering teams with high-quality, trusted data and self-serve analytics, while creating space for Data practitioners to focus on the highest-impact questions, opportunities and decisions.

Our Data discipline is centralised, but deeply embedded in Monzo’s product areas. Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers and Analysts work in cross-functional squads alongside Engineers, Designers, Product Managers, Marketers and other specialists. This means Data is not a downstream service: we help shape strategy, challenge thinking, build the data foundations teams need to move quickly, and share accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.

At Monzo, payments are more than just moving money from A to B. They are a core part of how customers experience trust, speed, and financial control every day. As a Data Director in Payments, you would help shape seamless local payment experiences, ensuring customers can pay and get paid reliably while continuing to modernise the infrastructure that powers millions of transactions behind the scenes.

The role also sits at the intersection of Monzo’s broader ambition to build truly borderless banking and expand into new markets. That means designing products and payment capabilities that work effortlessly across geographies, currencies, and customer needs, while helping Monzo scale into new markets with the same simplicity and transparency that defines the brand today.

You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Design to help shape Monzo’s payments strategy to make Monzo's global ambitions a reality, enabling revenue and customer growth with a resilient, self-serve banking platform. 

To succeed, you should be excited about solving tough, ambiguous business problems with analytical rigour, commercial viability and execution effectiveness

  • Establish yourself as a trusted member of the Payments Leadership team, enabling better decisions across Payments and the wider Data Discipline

  • Identify untapped opportunities for commercial optimisation, including across pricing, commercialisation, investment and customer growth

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

As one of the fastest-growing startups ever, we enable teams to secure cloud and AI applications by connecting code, cloud, and runtime into a single shared context. Trusted by security teams all over the world, we have a proven track record of success and a culture that values world-class talent. Our Wizards from all over the globe work together to protect the infrastructure of our customers, including over 65% of the Fortune 100, who trust us to scan and secure over 230 billion files daily. We’re honored to be a leading player in a massive and growing market, and we continue to look for exceptional Wizards who are eager to make a significant impact on our team. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. Come join our team and help us create secure cloud environments that allow even the best companies to move faster, all while having some fun!

Role Description

Wiz is looking for a Security Engineer for Product & Production Infrastructure who has experience performing security reviews, vulnerability management, and detection and response operations in cloud-native environments. You’ll get to collaborate with our software development and DevOps teams to secure Wiz’s products, CI/CD infrastructure, and production infrastructure. You’ll also have the opportunity to influence our product roadmap by utilizing Wiz-for-Wiz to assess, monitor, and harden our environments.

Responsibilities

  • Lead threat modeling and security reviews across Wiz's products and cloud infrastructure, identifying attack surfaces and developing scalable mitigation strategies.

  • Build automation, policy-as-code, and security tooling that enables development teams to "shift left" and integrate end-to-end security into their workflows.

  • Design and implement secure baselines for cloud resources and Kubernetes based infrastructure.

  • Drive vulnerability management and remediation efforts – prioritizing issues, implementing mitigations, and designing strategic preventative controls in software supply chains from development through production.

  • Extend our detection and response capabilities – building scalable solutions to identify malicious activity, triage alerts, and investigate and remediate incidents.

  • Build deep functional partnerships with Wiz's engineering and operations teams – helping them deliver secure-by-design solutions.

Minimum qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in security engineering or security operations work in cloud environments.

  • Experience with AWS cloud security (or equivalent experience in Azure and GCP with some level of AWS experience).

  • Experience with cloud native Kubernetes services (EKS/GKE/AKS) and container security principles.

  • Experience securing IAM and cloud identities at scale.

  • Experience leading technical security reviews of products and architectures, conducting threat modeling exercises, and translating findings into actionable security controls.

  • Practical understanding of web application security concepts (such as OWASP Top-10 and similar).

  • Hands-on experience with IaC and related tools (Terraform, CloudFormation, Helm, Pulumi).

  • Experience with automation and tooling development in one or more of the following: Python, Go, Shell, HCL, Rego.

Preferred qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, and/or equivalent job experience in lieu of a degree.

title: Senior Regulatory Officer (UK/EU) - THG Nutrition
description:
About THG 

We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition. 

Our portfolio of leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition. 

From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.  

With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for? 

Location: THG ICON, 7-9 Sunbank Ln, Altrincham WA15 0AF

Life at THG Nutrition

THG Nutrition is home to some of the world’s most trusted and best-loved wellbeing and nutrition brands, including Myprotein, the world’s largest online sports nutrition brand, alongside Myvitamins and MP Activewear.

Our brands and people exist to break boundaries — to power and empower those who want more. We move fast, challenge convention, and back ourselves to win. These values shape how we work every day.

 

About Regulatory & Compliance and the Role

The Regulatory and Compliance team's primary focus is to ensure product formulation, labelling and website compliance for all THG Nutrition and Beauty brands globally. THG owns and operates many leading brands including LookFantastic.com, Grow Gorgeous, Mio Skincare, ESPA and MyProtein.

THG is looking to recruit a Senior Regulatory Officer (UK / EU) with a good understanding of UK / EU Regulations pertaining to labelling of food and food supplements for UK/EU Countries, to join our Regulatory & Compliance Team. The role is reporting into the EU Regulatory Manager.

With a focus on brand protection, the Regulatory & Compliance Team plays a critical role in ensuring that our products can be marketed and sold legally all over the world. The role offers hybrid working from our Head Office near Manchester Airport, this role offers the opportunity to contribute to the Global success of The Hut Group and our market-leading brands.

Responsibilities:

  • Managing one Regulatory Associate, including setting objectives and cascading departmental objectives to direct reports.
  • Supporting from a regulatory position on key business projects.
  • Upkeep and maintenance of a comprehensive suite of applicable regulations and guidance.
  • Proactively identifying potential Regulatory / compliance issues and working together with the senior members of the team to reduce and/or eradicate their impact.
  • Oversee and input on regulatory requirements for New Product Development (NPD) and Existing Product Development (EPD) for THG Nutrition Brands including Myprotein, Myvegan, and Myvitamins.
  • Working closely with NPD on new formulations to ensure compliance in the UK and EU Member States.
  • Reviewing labelling, marketing material (including campaigns/scripts/clearcast/assets) to check that they are compliant with regulatory requirements.
  • Advising on nutrition and health claims, ensuring they are correctly worded on product labelling and websites.
  • Reviewing company websites to check that content is compliant with country specific regulatory requirements.
  • Completing food supplement product registration in in the UK and EU Member States.
  • Assessing regulatory risk against commercial requirements and completing risk assessments as and when necessary.
  • Participating in Trade Association meetings, review communications, gather relevant data to help lobby for change as and when relevant.
  • Horizon scanning - Using own initiative to define upcoming regulatory challenges in the UK / EU market based on changes in regulations and/or market trends.
  • Supporting on internal and external auditing including BRC and ISO (training provided).
  • Regularly review policies to ensure they are up to date.
  • Create training materials & provide training/upskilling for team members, wider teams and stakeholders as required.
  • Establishing and maintaining a strong working relationship with key stakeholders (NPD, Marketing, Brand, Commercial teams etc).
  • Supporting on routine nutrition analyses.

Requirements:

  • Qualification in Nutrition, Food Technology, Food Law, Food Science, Food Safety or other related subject.
  • Great understanding of regulations regarding food and food supplements and usage of claims in the UK/EU.
  • Great understanding of food industry standard practices.
  • Excellent attention to detail, strong communication skills and good time management.
  • Ability to communicate across different departments e.g. NPD, Brand, Marketing, SQA, QA, Packaging Artwork etc to ensure business needs are met.
  • Understanding of food supplement product registration process in EU Member States would be desirable but not essential.
  • Good IT Skills - (Email, Excel, Word and SharePoint).
  • Experience of product specification systems (especially Oracle Brand Compliance) would be desirable but not essential.
  • If you have experience managing, supporting and guiding a small team this would be an advantage.

What's in it for me?

Career Development

  • Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&D team.
  • Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider.

Enhanced Leave

  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.
  • Don't want to work on your birthday? We don't either! Enjoy your day off on us!
  • Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.
  • Up to 10 days compassionate leave.
  • Buy back up to 3 days each year.
  • Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12 months.

Wellbeing Support

  • Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP and Dentist.
  • Access our 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP), provided by Bupa.
  • State-of-the-art on-site gym.

Other Perks

  • Save up to 12% on the cost of personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme.
  • Subsidised bus pass from Manchester City Centre to our ICON office.
  • Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands.
  • On-site staff shop.
  • Know someone who would be perfect for THG? Refer them and get up to £1,000 when they pass their probation.
  • Anniversary gifts when you hit 5 and 10 years of service.
 

THG is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. If you are invited to interview, please let us know if there are any reasonable adjustments we can make to the recruitment process that will enable you to perform to the best of your ability.

THG is committed to creating a diverse & inclusive environment and hence welcomes applications from all sections of the community.

We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. If you haven't heard from us within that time frame or should you have any specific questions about this or other applications for positions at THG please contact one of our Talent team to discuss further.

description: About Relation Relation is a sector defining TechBio company developing transformational medicines, with technology at our core. We leverage single-cell multi-omics from patient tissue, functional assays, and machine learning to drive disease understanding, from cause to cure. We are scaling rapidly and building a team of exceptional individuals to push the boundaries of drug discovery. You will work in highly interdisciplinary teams where biology, computation, and engineering come together to solve complex problems that have not been solved before. Own the scientific compute platform, ensuring it reliably and efficiently meets the evolving needs of our Machine Learning and Data Science teams. Establish comprehensive observability and robust disaster recovery and failover strategies across on-premises and cloud environments. Own Relation’s platform security controls, including IAM, secrets management, network policy and vulnerability management, ensuring the platform meets the data governance standards required of a clinical-stage biotech working with sensitive patient-derived data. Experience leading engineers, either formally or informally, with responsibility for significant workstreams from strategy through to delivery. Deep expertise in Kubernetes, alongside experience operating infrastructure across hybrid on-premises and cloud environments. Experience building, running or evolving MLOps infrastructure, ideally including notebook environments such as Kubeflow, GPU compute for distributed training and model serving. Familiarity with batch compute for data-intensive scientific workloads, with an understanding of the reliability, scalability and reproducibility requirements of scientific data pipelines. A track record of maturing CI/CD pipelines, developer tooling and observability across complex, multi-environment platforms. Strong security fundamentals, with hands-on experience designing and implementing appropriate security controls. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to co-own strategy with senior stakeholders, challenge decisions constructively and communicate platform strategy clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Bonus Experience : Exposure to relevant compliance and governance frameworks, such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 or GDPR within a research or scientific environment. Personally, you Are comfortable working in a matrixed environment, balancing multiple stakeholders and contributing effectively across teams. Take ownership of your work , proactively seek opportunities to contribute, and enable others to do their best work. Technically deep enough to earn the respect of a highly skilled engineering team, while being equally comfortable influencing and contributing at leadership level Communicate openly and directly , give and receive feedback constructively, and handle challenging conversations with respect. Actively seek out diverse perspectives , build strong working relationships, and contribute to shared goals across teams. Embrace challenges with openness and resilience , set high standards for yourself, and strive to deliver meaningful outcomes. Working Style & Culture at Relation At Relation, we operate in a matrixed, interdisciplinary environment , where impact is driven through collaboration across scientific, technical, and operational domains. raw.jobDescription:
Who is Boulevard?

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come do the best work of your life at Boulevard.

We're hiring a Director of Engineering - Data to build and lead the technical foundation that powers Boulevard's data ecosystem and products. This role is responsible for our data infrastructure, data governance, ML capabilities and the underlying systems that enable data-driven products and decision-making across the company.

Reporting to the SVP of Engineering, you'll play a critical leadership role in establishing Boulevard's data platform as a strategic competitive advantage. Your work will shape how data is collected, processed, and leveraged across the company - driving insights, powering product innovation, and ensuring operational excellence. You will ensure that data is reliable, secure, performant, and accessible to support our growing customer base and internal teams. You'll lead a high-impact team of data engineers, with a mandate to grow and scale the organization. This is a foundational role where you'll architect and build systems that will support Boulevard's growth for years to come.

Domains of Ownership

  • Data Infrastructure & Platform Engineering - Build and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines and infrastructure
  • Data Products - Partner with the insights team, product management and product engineering to power reporting dashboards, analytics features, and data-driven customer experiences
  • Data Governance & Quality - Establish frameworks for data integrity, lineage, and compliance
  • Data Security & Privacy - Ensure data protection, access controls, and regulatory compliance (including HIPAA)
  • ML/AI Platform Operations - Provide the foundation and standards for machine learning and AI capabilities
  • Real-time & Batch Processing - Design and optimize data processing systems for various use cases
  • Data Integration & APIs - Enable seamless data flow between systems and external partners

Key Projects & Initiatives

  • Modern Data Infrastructure: Continue building out scalable data infrastructure using tools like dbt, Airflow, and real-time streaming platforms
  • Customer Data Products: Collaborate with Product Management and Product Engineering to deliver customer-facing reporting, dashboards, and analytics features
  • Data Platform for Insights: Build robust data pipelines that enable the Data Insights team to deliver external benchmarking and internal business intelligence
  • Data Governance Framework: Establish comprehensive data quality monitoring, lineage tracking, and governance policies
  • Platform Self-Service: Build tools and frameworks that enable other teams to safely and efficiently work with data
  • Security & Compliance: Strengthen data protection, access controls, and ensure HIPAA compliance across all data systems
  • Performance Optimization: Continuously improve cost, speed, and reliability of data processing systems
  • ML/AI Infrastructure: Provide robust foundation for training, deployment, and monitoring of machine learning models and LLMs

What You'll Do Here

  • Technical Leadership: Define and execute the long-term technical strategy for Boulevard's data platform, ensuring scalability and reliability as we grow
  • Team Building: Lead, mentor, and grow a team of data platform engineers, establishing best practices and fostering a culture of excellence
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Product Management, Product Engineering, and the Data Insights team to understand requirements and deliver platform capabilities that enable customer-facing data products and internal insights
  • Architecture & Design: Drive architectural decisions for data systems, balancing current needs with future flexibility and scalability
  • Operational Excellence: Establish monitoring, alerting, and operational practices that ensure high availability and performance of data systems
  • Standards & Governance: Define and implement data governance policies, security standards, and quality frameworks across the organization
  • Strategic Planning: Work with leadership to align data platform roadmap with business objectives and technical strategy

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • 10+ years of experience in data platform engineering, distributed systems, or infrastructure engineering, with deep expertise in building scalable data processing systems
  • 5+ years of people management experience, including managing senior engineers and technical leads
  • Proven track record of building data platforms and ML systems that support both internal analytics and customer-facing data products
  • Experience delivering customer-facing reporting, dashboards, and analytics features in collaboration with Product teams
  • Strong experience with modern data stack technologies (dbt, Airflow, Snowflake, Kafka, etc.)
  • Deep understanding of data governance, quality frameworks, and security best practices
  • A strategic mindset with the ability to translate business goals into technical roadmaps, balancing short-term execution with long-term vision.

How We'll Take Care of You

At Boulevard, we work hard to structure compensation in a way that balances internal equity with local market competitiveness, and we’re happy to share a good-faith estimate of the base salary range for this role. For U.S. based candidates, the anticipated base salary range is $220,000 - $270,000 per year. In addition to this base compensation, this role may be eligible to participate in a variable compensation program. Final compensation will vary based on a variety of factors which include but are not limited to applicable experience, location, and final leveling.

In addition to the wonderful people you'll get to work with and challenging projects that'll push you:

  • ✨ We've got you covered with a 401(k) match plus dental, medical, vision, and life insurance
  • Take a break whenever you need with our flexible vacation day policy
  • Fully remote so you can choose where you want to work. You'll receive a work from home stipend every month
  • Family planning resources and specialized support programs
  • Equity: get ahead on the ground floor and grow with Boulevard
  • Boulevard Bucks Learning and Development program allows employees to explore businesses in the market we serve

title: Senior Product Designer (Contract), London, UK
description:
About Eucalyptus

We're on a mission to make good health last a lifetime. More than 1 billion people live with obesity worldwide, driving preventable chronic conditions. We're here to build better long-term care.

 

Eucalyptus is now part of Hims & Hers, the global leader in personalised health and wellness.

 

Euc is the company behind Juniper, one of the world's largest weight-management programs combining GLP-1 medication with personalised nutrition, movement support, and clinician-led care from prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists, and dietitians. Our published clinical research shows that our combined clinical and behavioural approach helps patients lose significantly more weight during their treatment with Juniper by four times.

Our Growth Story:

  • Supporting patients living with obesity across our 5 markets
  • Received selective NICE endorsement to provide services to the NHS
  • Tailored our offering to thousands of patients in Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan and Canada.

About Eucalyptus

We're on a mission to make good health last a lifetime. More than 1 billion people live with obesity worldwide, driving preventable chronic conditions. We're here to build better long-term care.

Eucalyptus is now part of Hims & Hers, the global leader in personalised health and wellness.

Euc is the company behind Juniper, one of the world's largest weight-management programs combining GLP-1 medication with personalised nutrition, movement support, and clinician-led care from prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists, and dietitians. Our published clinical research shows that our combined clinical and behavioural approach helps patients lose significantly more weight during their treatment with Juniper by four times.

Our Growth Story:

  • 130% YoY revenue growth and a 90% reduction in cash burn - culminating in our $1.15bn acquisition by Hims & Hers in 2026, giving us the platform to take long-term care global
  • Supported over 350k patients living with obesity across our 5 markets
  • Received selective NICE endorsement to provide services to the NHS
  • Tailored our offering to thousands of patients in Australia, the UK, Germany, Japan and Canada 

You're a talented Senior Product Designer with a passion for health and excitement about building our expanding healthcare platform. You enjoy working in dynamic environments, solving complex problems, and creating thoughtful, user-centred design solutions that make a real impact.

In this role, you will:

  • Own a problem area across connected surfaces, not a queue of screens, from definition to delivery.
  • Research it, design it, write it, test it, measure it, iterate. You drive it without waiting for a spec.
  • Move commercial outcomes on your surface: activation, conversion through regulated intake, retention, adherence. You know which metric you are moving and why.
  • Create designs that build trust and hold up in a regulated market.

What good looks like

  • Scope: you own a problem area end to end.
  • Impact: you moved a meaningful metric and can show the before and after.
  • Influence: you raise the bar around you. You give sharp critique. You make junior designers better without being asked to.

About you (who you are)

You're a talented Senior Product Designer with a passion for health and excitement about building our expanding healthcare platform. You enjoy working in dynamic environments, solving complex problems, and creating thoughtful, user-centred design solutions that make a real impact.

Skills & experience

  • Problem definition. You shape the problem, not just the pixels. Using research, data and the input of others, you break the ambiguity down and package it back up into something the team can build. The signal is evidence you helped define the right problem, not just made the screens.
  • Visual craft. Non-negotiable. Typography, spacing, colour, motion and micro-interactions, used with intent, not decoration. Weak craft is a no, whatever the strategy talk.
  • Accessibility. You design inclusively without being asked. You know why the standard exists, not just what it says, and it shows in judgement calls a checklist cannot make.
  • Systems thinking. You design across surfaces, from mobile to emerging platforms like AI-native interfaces, and contribute to the system others build on. Infrastructure compounds. Single screens do not.
  • Product and commercial sense. You shaped what got built. Metrics, research and commercial awareness sit next to the work. Craft in isolation moves nothing.
  • Communication. Clear, specific, opinionated. You say what you decided and why, and you are just as clear on what you chose not to do and why.
  • Working in the open. You share early and often, and you use critique to sharpen the work. You lift the quality of every review you join.
How you work with AI
  • LLMs are already embedded in your workflow.
  • You prototype in tools like Claude Code and Cursor to test ideas in real code, not just mock them up. Tighter build-measure-learn loops.
  • The signal is workflow, not tool count. Judgement spent where it counts.
The full stack

We expect you to work end to end, from problem definition and research to information architecture and UX writing.

  • Your own research and usability testing.
  • Validation and experimentation. You set up A/B tests and read them honestly.
  • UX writing. In a regulated market, this is craft and compliance at once.
  • Problem definition. Break it down. Package it back up.
Your portfolio

Show problem solving that moved a commercial lever, not just well-made screens. We want evidence of the outcome, the craft behind it, the care in the finish, how you contributed to the Design System, and where AI tightened your process. How you write it says as much as what you show. Concise and clear is a signal of how you communicate. Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

Experience

Typically 5 to 8 years in product design, with a track record of owning problems end to end and influencing direction at a team level.

Behaviours & attitude

  • Patient-first mindset. You put patient outcomes first. Every decision weighs commercial growth against clinical safety and care, and you don't let one erode the other. You understand real health journeys well enough to make them simple, accessible and worth trusting.
  • Collaborative creation. You work well across product, engineering and clinical, and you know a good idea can come from any of them. You listen to feedback and take it on, using it to make the work better.
  • Curiosity. You ask why before how. You stay curious about the patient, the problem and the tools you use to solve it, and you're comfortable being a beginner when something new is worth learning.

Why join Eucalyptus?

Euc is also behind a growing family of digital healthcare clinics (Pilot, Kin, Software) across men’s health and well-being, fertility, and skincare.

Here’s what makes joining Euc unique:

  • What’s next - Our goal for the next three years is to support 1 million patients globally to live better for longer. We’re launching into new conditions, demographics, and geographies as we build a truly preventive healthcare ecosystem.
  • Build something world-changing - We’re on the path to becoming the world’s largest international digital healthcare company. It will be challenging, fast-paced, and deeply rewarding.
  • Make real impact - You will deliver work that directly shapes patient outcomes and scales evidence-based care across markets.
  • Accelerate your growth - You will have high ownership, continuous feedback, and dedicated development support.
  • Join a motivated team - You will collaborate with talented peers to solve complex clinical and operational problems at scale.

What’s ahead in the UK

  • Opportunity to convert to an FTE role
    • Become an owner – Your own stake in the business with our employee options program
      Invest in your growth – Annual development budget plus 3 days of professional development leave
      Work flexibly – Hybrid setup with 3 days a week in our Old Street office, designed for focus and collaboration
      Support your well-being – Private health insurance through Vitality or opt for a monthly wellness allowance to spend on what matters most to you
      Take time off – 25 days of holiday, enhanced parental leave and work from anywhere 3 weeks out of the year
  • Join a connected team – A vibrant office culture with regular socials, clubs, after-school sport, and seasonal events

 

At Eucalyptus, we value individuals from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we embrace the unique qualities each person brings. When you apply, please let us know of any reasonable adjustments you may need during the interview process. We use AI-assisted tools across our business to help our teams work more efficiently, including within our recruitment process. These tools support our team — all hiring decisions are made by real people, and every application is reviewed by a member of our recruitment team.

title: EMEA Account Executive
description:
About Netcraft

Netcraft is the global leader in cybercrime detection and disruption. We’re a trusted partner for three of the four largest companies in the world and many large governments. We've blocked over 225 million cyber-attacks to date, and we take down around 33% of the world's phishing attacks.

Our purpose and passion are focused on just one thing: protecting the world from cybercrime.

That passion shapes how we work, too. We’re proud of our talented team and the value each person brings, and we’ve built a workplace where people feel supported and inspired. From strong benefits and wellness programs to meaningful collaboration and team connection. 

 

The Role
Reporting directly to the Director of Sales and working closely with colleagues across the UK and other global teams, this role is wholly focused on winning net new enterprise customers across the EMEA region.
This is a pure new business role. You will be responsible for
identifying, developing, and closing high-value opportunities with net new customers, operating with a high degree of ownership across the full new business sales cycle.

Why join Netcraft’s commercial team?
You will be joining a high-performing commercial organisation with a strong track record of growth and execution. Over recent years, the team has consistently delivered against target, with:
  • 100%+ attainment against ARR targets across multiple years
  • 90%+ of fully ramped Account Executives exceeding annual targets in 2025
  • 60%+ year-on-year growth in New Sales ARR in 2025
  • Several of the largest new business deals in company history closed in recent quarters
This is what you’ll be doing, day to day: 
  • Driving net new business across the EMEA region and securing contracts with new enterprise customers against target
  • Owning the full sales cycle from initial engagement through to close
  • Building and maintaining strong pipeline coverage through a combination of self-generated outbound activity and qualified inbound opportunities
  • Prospecting daily through channels such as email, LinkedIn, phone, and strategic outreach
  • Engaging senior stakeholders to understand business challenges and requirements, particularly in relation to cybersecurity and digital risk
  • Leading commercial conversations and positioning Netcraft’s value clearly in complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
  • Drafting and delivering compelling proposals, working closely with technical teams where needed to address customer requirements
  • Maintaining accurate pipeline visibility and ensuring Salesforce is updated consistently with high-quality activity and account notes

title: Head EMEA Refund Fraud, Integrity - Fixed Term Contract
description: About the Role The head of EMEA Refund Fraud will lead Doordash’s EMEA strategy for preventing and managing refund abuse across our marketplace. You will be accountable for the performance of the Credit and Refund (C&R) Fraud domain: setting the long-term vision, determining where we focus our resources, and building the team, controls and capabilities required to reduce fraud sustainably while protecting the experience of genuine customers. This is a senior leadership role at the intersection of Integrity, Customer Care, Product, Engineering, Analytics and Finance. You will lead a team of experienced fraud and strategy professionals and work with senior leaders across Deliveroo to make complex decisions about fraud risk, customer experience, operational cost and product investment. You will need to be comfortable operating in ambiguity, identifying problems before they become material, and turning complex and sometimes incomplete signals into a clear strategy. Success will come not from personally solving every problem, but from creating the direction, operating mechanisms and team that enable Deliveroo to manage refund fraud effectively at scale. What You’ll Be Doing Setting the C&R Fraud Strategy Set and own the 1–2 year vision and strategy for C&R Fraud, translating wider Integrity and business priorities into a focused roadmap. Proactively identify emerging risks, systemic vulnerabilities and opportunities rather than waiting for problems to be assigned. Determine the highest-value problems for the team to solve and make clear choices about where we should (and should not) invest. Define how we balance fraud loss, customer experience, operational cost and growth when designing controls. Build compelling business cases for significant product, policy and operational investments. Owning Performance and Risk Be accountable for C&R Fraud performance and establish a clear set of outcomes, targets and guardrails. Develop a comprehensive view of fraud exposure, including fraud cost, abuse rates, loss per order, false positives, customer impact and operational cost. Partner with Finance and senior leadership to quantify financial exposure and inform risk appetite decisions. Establish mechanisms to identify material changes in performance, understand their drivers and ensure effective action is taken. Ensure the organisation can detect and respond quickly to new abuse patterns and emerging threats. Build Scalable Fraud Prevention Capabilities Own the effectiveness of the overall C&R fraud framework across customer and partner journeys. Identify systemic control gaps and ensure the right preventative, detective and responsive controls are in place. Set the direction for product decisioning, eligibility logic, automation, friction, policies and operational interventions. Ensure rules, models and controls are continually evaluated against both fraud outcomes and customer-experience guardrails. Create effective feedback loops between frontline investigations, Analytics, Product and Engineering so that new insights translate into better prevention. Challenge legacy processes and controls, simplifying or retiring them where they no longer provide sufficient value. Lead Cross-Functional Strategy and Investment Act as the senior C&R Fraud partner to Product, Engineering, Customer Care, Merchant, Finance, Analytics and other Integrity teams. Translate fraud problems into clear product and business opportunities and influence roadmaps outside your direct reporting line. Lead complex decisions where fraud prevention, customer experience, commercial performance and operational efficiency are in tension. Create alignment around priorities, decision rights and accountability without relying on excessive consensus. Make longer-term trade-offs and ensure resources are concentrated on the initiatives with the greatest expected impact. Communicate complex risks and recommendations clearly to senior and executive stakeholders. Build and Lead a High-Performing Team Lead and develop a team of experienced fraud, strategy and operations professionals. Translate your strategy into clear, measurable outcomes for individual team members. Empower your team to own significant problems independently while providing effective challenge, coaching and direction. Establish strong operating mechanisms and rituals for reviewing performance, prioritisation, delivery and emerging risks. Build capability and succession within the team, identifying development opportunities and future talent needs. Create an inclusive environment in which different perspectives are actively sought and people are able to challenge assumptions. Hold yourself and others accountable for delivering ambitious outcomes while maintaining focus and sustainable ways of working. Requirements We are looking for an experienced leader who has previously owned a meaningful fraud, risk, trust & safety, operational or related business domain. You will ideally bring: Significant experience in fraud, risk strategy, trust & safety, marketplace integrity, strategy & operations or a related domain, typically gained over 10+ years. Experience leading and developing experienced individual contributors and/or managers. Demonstrated ownership of a substantial business outcome, risk domain or portfolio rather than solely individual projects. A track record of defining and executing strategies across a 1–2 year horizon. Experience identifying complex problems, setting direction and making high-quality decisions where the answer is not immediately clear. Strong commercial judgement and the ability to evaluate financial impact alongside customer and operational consequences. Experience influencing senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Operations, Analytics and Finance. Strong analytical judgement and the ability to use data, customer insight and operational evidence to challenge assumptions and make decisions. Experience translating complex problems into scalable product, policy or operational solutions. Strong people leadership, with evidence of developing talented individuals and creating teams that operate effectively with increasing autonomy. Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn complex analysis into clear executive-level recommendations. Experience with refund abuse, customer claims fraud, payments fraud, marketplace abuse or adjacent fraud domains would be valuable, but deep expertise in refund fraud itself is not essential. We are equally interested in leaders who have demonstrated the ability to quickly understand a complex risk domain and build the strategy and organisation required to improve it. What Success Looks Like In this role, you will have built a clear and widely understood C&R Fraud strategy, established measurable outcomes and guardrails, and focused the organisation on a number of high-impact priorities. You will have materially improved our ability to prevent and respond to refund abuse while protecting genuine customers, created a scalable control and monitoring framework, and influenced the product investments required to address systemic vulnerabilities. You will have built a team capable of owning complex problems independently — creating an organisation that anticipates risk and continuously improves rather than reacting to the fraud we see today. Why Deliveroo Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it. We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas. Workplace & Benefits At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information. Diversity At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry. We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. We recognise that some candidates may require adjustments to apply for a position or fairly participate in the interview process. If you require any adjustments, please don't hesitate to let us know. You will lead a team of experienced fraud and strategy professionals and work with senior leaders across Deliveroo to make complex decisions about fraud risk, customer experience, operational cost and product investment.

You will need to be comfortable operating in ambiguity, identifying problems before they become material, and turning complex and sometimes incomplete signals into a clear strategy. Success will come not from personally solving every problem, but from creating the direction, operating mechanisms and team that enable Deliveroo to manage refund fraud effectively at scale.

What You’ll Be Doing

  1. Setting the C&R Fraud Strategy

    • Set and own the 1–2 year vision and strategy for C&R Fraud, translating wider Integrity and business priorities into a focused roadmap.

    • Proactively identify emerging risks, systemic vulnerabilities and opportunities rather than waiting for problems to be assigned.

    • Determine the highest-value problems for the team to solve and make clear choices about where we should (and should not) invest.

    • Define how we balance fraud loss, customer experience, operational cost and growth when designing controls.

    • Build compelling business cases for significant product, policy and operational investments.

  2. Owning Performance and Risk

    • Be accountable for C&R Fraud performance and establish a clear set of outcomes, targets and guardrails.

    • Develop a comprehensive view of fraud exposure, including fraud cost, abuse rates, loss per order, false positives, customer impact and operational cost.

    • Partner with Finance and senior leadership to quantify financial exposure and inform risk appetite decisions.

    • Establish mechanisms to identify material changes in performance, understand their drivers and ensure effective action is taken.

    • Ensure the organisation can detect and respond quickly to new abuse patterns and emerging threats.

  3. Build Scalable Fraud Prevention Capabilities

    • Own the effectiveness of the overall C&R fraud framework across customer and partner journeys.

    • Identify systemic control gaps and ensure the right preventative, detective and responsive controls are in place.

    • Set the direction for product decisioning, eligibility logic, automation, friction, policies and operational interventions.

    • Ensure rules, models and controls are continually evaluated against both fraud outcomes and customer-experience guardrails.

    • Create effective feedback loops between frontline investigations, Analytics, Product and Engineering so that new insights translate into better prevention.

    • Challenge legacy processes and controls, simplifying or retiring them where they no longer provide sufficient value.

  4. Lead Cross-Functional Strategy and Investment

    • Act as the senior C&R Fraud partner to Product, Engineering, Customer Care, Merchant, Finance, Analytics and other Integrity teams.

    • Translate fraud problems into clear product and business opportunities and influence roadmaps outside your direct reporting line.

    • Lead complex decisions where fraud prevention, customer experience, commercial performance and operational efficiency are in tension.

    • Create alignment around priorities, decision rights and accountability without relying on excessive consensus.

    • Make longer-term trade-offs and ensure resources are concentrated on the initiatives with the greatest expected impact.

    • Communicate complex risks and recommendations clearly to senior and executive stakeholders.

  5. Build and Lead a High-Performing Team

    • Lead and develop a team of experienced fraud, strategy and operations professionals.

    • Translate your strategy into clear, measurable outcomes for individual team members.

    • Empower your team to own significant problems independently while providing effective challenge, coaching and direction.

    • Establish strong operating mechanisms and rituals for reviewing performance, prioritisation, delivery and emerging risks.

    • Build capability and succession within the team, identifying development opportunities and future talent needs.

    • Create an inclusive environment in which different perspectives are actively sought and people are able to challenge assumptions.

    • Hold yourself and others accountable for delivering ambitious outcomes while maintaining focus and sustainable ways of working.

Requirements

We are looking for an experienced leader who has previously owned a meaningful fraud, risk, trust & safety, operational or related business domain. You will ideally bring:

  • Significant experience in fraud, risk strategy, trust & safety, marketplace integrity, strategy & operations or a related domain, typically gained over 10+ years.

  • Experience leading and developing experienced individual contributors and/or managers.

  • Demonstrated ownership of a substantial business outcome, risk domain or portfolio rather than solely individual projects.

  • A track record of defining and executing strategies across a 1–2 year horizon.

  • Experience identifying complex problems, setting direction and making high-quality decisions where the answer is not immediately clear.

  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to evaluate financial impact alongside customer and operational consequences.

  • Experience influencing senior stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Operations, Analytics and Finance.

  • Strong analytical judgement and the ability to use data, customer insight and operational evidence to challenge assumptions and make decisions.

  • Experience translating complex problems into scalable product, policy or operational solutions.

  • Strong people leadership, with evidence of developing talented individuals and creating teams that operate effectively with increasing autonomy.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including the ability to turn complex analysis into clear executive-level recommendations.

Experience with refund abuse, customer claims fraud, payments fraud, marketplace abuse or adjacent fraud domains would be valuable, but deep expertise in refund fraud itself is not essential. We are equally interested in leaders who have demonstrated the ability to quickly understand a complex risk domain and build the strategy and organisation required to improve it.

What Success Looks Like

  • In this role, you will have built a clear and widely understood C&R Fraud strategy, established measurable outcomes and guardrails, and focused the organisation on a number of high-impact priorities.

  • You will have materially improved our ability to prevent and respond to refund abuse while protecting genuine customers, created a scalable control and monitoring framework, and influenced the product investments required to address systemic vulnerabilities.

  • You will have built a team capable of owning complex problems independently — creating an organisation that anticipates risk and continuously improves rather than reacting to the fraud we see today.

raw.title: Marketing Operations Manager
raw.description:
Tangible is a fast-growing, tech-driven platform providing liquidity solutions to LPs in the private markets. We combine deep sector expertise with modern infrastructure to unlock liquidity across private equity, private credit, and real assets.

As we scale, we are looking for a Marketing Operations Manager to build and manage the infrastructure that connects our marketing activity with sales. This is a hands-on role focused on making HubSpot a powerful operating system for understanding contact engagement, identifying intent signals, delivering relevant nurture, and helping our sales team engage the right people at the right time.

This is not an inbound lead-generation or MQL-focused role. The objective is to understand how contacts are engaging with Tangible over time — what they are reading, which campaigns they respond to, what they do on our website, and other relevant signals — so that we can identify increasing levels of interest and act quickly.

You will own the day-to-day marketing operations architecture in HubSpot, while also managing nurture campaigns, marketing messaging and the operational side of content. You will work closely with leadership and Sales to ensure our marketing activity generates useful signals and actionable intelligence, rather than simply producing more leads.

Tasks

HubSpot & Marketing Operations

  • Own and manage Tangible's HubSpot marketing operations architecture.
  • Build, maintain and optimise HubSpot workflows, properties, lists, segmentation, campaigns and automation.
  • Ensure HubSpot is correctly structured to capture and connect engagement data across marketing channels.
  • Develop robust processes for tracking contact engagement across email, website activity, content consumption, campaigns and other relevant touchpoints.
  • Maintain data quality, contact lifecycle processes and the overall integrity of the marketing database.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the way HubSpot supports Marketing and Sales as the business scales.
  • Ensure marketing activity is properly tracked and connected to the CRM so engagement can be understood at an individual contact level.

Engagement Scoring & Intent Signals

  • Build and continuously refine contact engagement scoring based on meaningful behavioural signals.
  • Develop scoring models that help us understand when an existing contact is becoming more engaged or showing increased intent.
  • Combine signals such as content engagement, website activity, email interactions, campaign participation and other relevant behaviours.
  • Use scoring to help Sales identify who is becoming more engaged and who should be contacted sooner.
  • Continuously test and refine scoring logic based on what actually proves useful to Sales.
  • Clearly communicate engagement signals and changes in contact behaviour to the sales team.
  • Ensure scoring is used as a prioritisation and intelligence tool, rather than simply as an inbound lead/MQL qualification model.

Nurture & Marketing Automation

  • Design, build and manage nurture programmes in HubSpot.
  • Develop segmented nurture journeys based on audience, interests, engagement and stage of relationship.
  • Manage the messaging, sequencing and logic behind automated campaigns.
  • Test subject lines, messaging, timing, segmentation and calls to action to improve engagement.
  • Identify opportunities to move contacts between different nurture journeys based on their behaviour.
  • Monitor campaign performance and continuously optimise programmes based on engagement and commercial outcomes.

Messaging & Sales Enablement

  • Work closely with Sales to understand the messaging and information they need to engage prospects effectively.
  • Develop and manage marketing messaging for nurture campaigns, email campaigns and other targeted communications.
  • Support Sales with relevant outreach messaging, follow-ups, campaign assets and other enablement materials.
  • Use engagement data and audience behaviour to inform messaging and help Sales personalise outreach.
  • Help Sales understand how to interpret and act on engagement signals coming from HubSpot.
  • Identify content and messaging that can support specific sales conversations and commercial priorities.

Content Operations
Content is not the primary responsibility of this role. Instead, you will ensure that Tangible's content is properly integrated into our marketing operations infrastructure.

  • Ensure content assets, reports, newsletters and other marketing activity are properly connected to HubSpot.
  • Make sure content engagement can be tracked at the contact level and incorporated into relevant segmentation and scoring.
  • Work with the wider team to ensure campaigns and content launches are set up correctly from an operational perspective.
  • Identify opportunities to use existing content within nurture programmes and sales journeys.
  • Report on which content is generating meaningful engagement and signals of interest.

Reporting & Optimisation

  • Build clear reporting around contact engagement, campaign performance, nurture activity and sales signals.
  • Provide leadership and Sales with actionable insight rather than vanity metrics.
  • Identify patterns in contact behaviour and engagement that can inform marketing and sales activity.
  • Measure the effectiveness of nurture programmes, scoring models and marketing campaigns.
  • Continuously improve the marketing operations infrastructure based on data, feedback and commercial outcomes.

Strategic Collaboration

  • Work closely with leadership and Sales to align marketing operations with commercial priorities.
  • Partner with Sales to ensure engagement signals are genuinely useful in day-to-day prospecting and relationship management.
  • Help establish the processes and infrastructure required as Tangible's marketing and sales activity scales.
  • Act as the internal owner and subject-matter expert for HubSpot marketing operations.

Requirements

  • 3–6 years' experience in marketing operations, marketing automation, CRM, lifecycle marketing or a closely related B2B marketing role.
  • Strong hands-on experience implementing and managing HubSpot architecture. This is a must-have.
  • Demonstrable experience building and managing HubSpot workflows, properties, lists, segmentation, campaigns and automation.
  • Experience designing and managing engagement or behavioural scoring models.
  • A strong understanding of how behavioural signals can be used to prioritise contacts and improve Sales engagement.
  • Experience building and optimising nurture campaigns and automated customer/prospect journeys.
  • Comfortable working across Marketing and Sales and translating commercial requirements into practical marketing-operations solutions.
  • Strong understanding of contact data, segmentation, lifecycle management and CRM hygiene.
  • Able to analyse engagement data and turn it into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Strong copywriting and messaging skills, particularly for B2B audiences and nurture campaigns.
  • Commercially minded, with an understanding that marketing operations should ultimately help Sales have better conversations with the right people.
  • Highly organised, analytical and detail-oriented.
  • Comfortable owning the function independently and building processes from the ground up.
  • Experience in private markets, PE/VC, financial services or another complex B2B environment is preferred.

What You'll Own

This is a hands-on role with genuine ownership. You will be responsible for making sure Tangible's marketing infrastructure works properly — from the underlying HubSpot architecture through to scoring, segmentation, nurture and the signals delivered to Sales.

The ideal person is someone who enjoys building systems, understanding how people behave, and turning data into action. You should be equally comfortable getting deep into a HubSpot workflow and working with Sales on how a particular engagement signal should change their approach.

You will have the opportunity to build the marketing operations function as Tangible scales, with significant ownership over the systems, processes and programmes that connect marketing activity to revenue.

About Us

Since 2013, we’ve been building a CRM that gets out of your way and helps your team sell more, faster. Now we’re building AI into every part of it, so Close does the busywork and your team does the selling. No manual data entry, no 10-click workflows. Just communication-first, AI-powered sales software designed to help you succeed and scale.

We're bootstrapped and profitable which means we answer to our customers and play by our rules. We're proud of our 120-person, 100% remote team, focused on building Close so that no small, scaling business fails because it can't figure out sales.

Our Stack

Our frontend is a single-page TypeScript web app built in React. We bundle with Vite and target modern browsers only. We test with Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright, and Chromatic for visual regression. Our UI updates in near real-time using WebSockets and WebRTC, is styled via CSS modules, and is performance-tuned with route-based code splitting and skeleton UI. We've built our own design system, documented in an extensive Storybook.

We sweat the UI/UX details and work collaboratively with Product throughout the design process - from lo-fi wireframes through Figma and into code. Our frontend is built on top of our REST API and GraphQL endpoints, backed by a Python/Flask/FastAPI, MongoDB, Postgres and Elasticsearch stack running on AWS.

We love open sourcing our code and ideas on our GitHub and on The Making of Close, our behind-the-scenes Product & Engineering blog. Check our projects such as react-custom-scroller, use-infinite-scroll, use-abortable-effect, and smart-tooltip-delay or insights from our day-to-day work like Under the Hood: Developing Close's AI-Powered Call Assistant, Cutting our Lead page LCP by half, and Highlights From a Complex Downshift.js Refactor.

AI is both how we build and what we ship, and that's reshaped what engineering looks like. This is a transformation we’re embracing and find deeply exciting.

About the Role

The Growth team owns the surfaces that turn someone who just signed up into a paying customer who sticks around — onboarding, activation, billing and checkout. The operating mode is simple: find the fastest path to learning, ship it, then standardize and clean up. The Growth team ships in weeks what other teams might take months to do.

Two of our exciting projects right now:

  • Agent-forward experience. We're exploring how agents and AI can make the experience better for our customers and demonstrate the value of Close faster. Our focus is helping users get real value from the product, not just automating on their behalf.

  • Creating data from unstructured sources. We're building ways to turn the information customers already have, like their inbox, into a working CRM, so they can skip the manual data entry and see value from Close faster.

One thing to know up front: we do move people between teams as the work shifts. Most engineers here end up on more than one team over their time at Close.

You are

  • A seasoned frontend engineer. React is our bread and butter, but perhaps you've worked across Vue, Svelte, or Solid. You pick the right tool for the problem rather than retreating to what you know. You've seen a variety of problems, can collaborate and self-direct.

  • Fluent in experimentation. You understand what data points to capture in an experiment, what a funnel looks like, and how to design a feature so it produces meaningful data — not just ship it and hope. This is the core of the role.

  • Experienced with B2B experiment structure. A strong bonus: you've worked in Amplitude on the implementation side, not just the technical configuration side.

  • Building AI-powered interfaces. You've shipped LLM-backed features for real users and have an opinion on where they're trustworthy, where they fall over, and how to make them feel reliable. You know how to design for streamed responses, uncertain states, and agent-driven UIs.

  • Working with AI daily. You use AI tools in your own workflow to ship faster, write tighter code, and reason about unfamiliar parts of the codebase. We fund the use of AI tools (Claude Code, Codex, and other best-in-class developer tools) and treat learning and experimentation as part of the work.

  • A builder first. You'd rather get the first iteration of a feature in front of fifty customers than spend three weeks fretting over a perfect PR. You ship — and you're comfortable standardizing and cleaning up after the learning lands.

You will

  • Build agent-forward onboarding. An agent that teaches by doing: clicking around, highlighting, demonstrating the app while it talks to the user. You'll own the UI layer that makes an agent feel like a trainer instead of a chat window — and help find the balance between the agent doing everything and the user learning enough to make Close's workflow their own.

  • Turn an inbox into a CRM. Build the experience around our unstructured-data pipeline: a user connects their email, and we surface detected deals, contacts, and a full book of business. Your job is making that moment feel like magic — and making it trustworthy enough to act on.

  • Design experiments, not just features. Decide what to instrument, define the funnel, and structure metrics so a B2B reality (org-level conversion, user-level behavior) still yields clean answers. You'll own this in Amplitude end to end.

  • Work across the whole app. Growth doesn't stay in its lane — onboarding, activation, billing, import, and whatever surface the next experiment needs. The Growth team experiments touch every aspect of the product.

  • Move at learning speed. Fastest path to insight first, then standardize and clean up. You'll ship in weeks what elsewhere takes months, and help decide which prototypes deserve to become permanent.

  • Have ownership and autonomy. The team is relatively new. How Growth frontend engineering works at Close is, in part, yours to shape.

Tech you'll touch: TypeScript, React, Vite, Amplitude, CSS Modules, Storybook, Playwright, WebSockets — plus the agent stack behind Chloe.

Benefits

  • Compensation: Competitive pay plus an organization-wide goal-based bonus

  • Paid Time Off: ~5 weeks of PTO to start. Plus a 1-week all-company Winter Holiday Break and paid US holidays. You'll earn 2 extra days for every year you're with Close.

  • 80% Work Option: Work with your manager to choose between a standard 5-day week or a 4-day week at 80% pay

  • Parental Leave: Paid leave for primary and secondary caregivers

  • Sabbatical: A 1-month paid sabbatical every 5 years with the team

  • Healthcare (US residents): Two medical plans with Close covering 99% of your premium, plus Dental, Vision, HSA, FSA, and company-paid Long-Term Disability

  • 401k (US residents): We match your contributions up to 6%, vested immediately

Our Values

Build a house you want to live in - Examine long-term thinking and action

No BS - Practice transparency and honesty, especially when it’s hard

Invest in each other - Build successful relationships with your coworkers and customers

Discipline equals freedom - Keep your word to yourself and others

Strive for greatness - Constantly challenge yourself and others

Learn More

Listen to our CEO and Founder, Steli Efti, tell the story of Close’s journey in the $0-30m Blueprint.

Watch our culture video from our 2023 team retreat in Milan. Every year our entire team gathers in person to build connection, foster cross-functional collaboration, and have fun. In 2027, we're headed to Dusseldorf, Germany!

Explore our product. Check out a demo!

Our Hiring Process

We ask a few role-specific questions as part of our application process. These questions are designed to help us learn more about you from the start, so please answer each one thoughtfully. We see this as an opportunity to get to know you beyond your resume.

We use AI tools daily at Close and expect candidates to do the same. In evaluating your application, we aim to get a sense for you - the way you think, how you communicate, the work you've done. Applications that read as fully AI-generated will not be considered.

Regardless of fit, you can expect to hear back from our team with an update on the status of your candidacy.

If you progress to the interview process, you'll receive a full outline of the role-specific steps in your first touchpoint with us. We do our best to make the hiring process clear and human.
